description: Reviewed, intentional differences between the baseline and the upgraded build. Every instance is still listed in the report; anything not matched here fails the comparison.

rules.reason: Only the human-readable `message` of a Spring Boot error response differs; status, `error`, `path` and the set of fields are identical. The wording comes from the framework and JDK (Spring 6 dropped 'nested exception is ...', Jackson 2.17 rephrased parse errors, Spring 6.1 reports 'No static resource ...' for unmapped paths, and JDK 14+ adds helpful NullPointerException messages).
Spring Framework 6 adds OPTIONS to the Allow header of its built-in OPTIONS handling. The status and empty body are unchanged; the old value was incomplete (GET was also allowed).
